fieldValues.title: Write in paragraphs
fieldValues.summary: Your essay is a list of paragraphs. Each paragraph is kept on its own, so it can be linked, commented on and moved. Give a paragraph a short title when you know what it says. Click a paragraph to edit it, and use the toolbar for bold, headings, lists and links. Your words are stored as plain text (markdown), so you can read them in any text editor. If you would rather type the formatting marks yourself, choose **Edit as markdown** in the View menu.
